newsitem.title: USA: Keystone completes Financial Trust purchase.
newsitem.headline: Keystone completes Financial Trust purchase.

text.p: Keystone Financial Inc said Monday it completed the takeover of Financial Trust Co May 30.
Under the agreement, Financial Trust shareholders will receive 1.65 Keystone shares, or $49.0875, for each of their 8.5 million outstanding shares, based on Keystone's Friday close of $29.75.

With the takeover of Financial Trust, which had $1.2 billion in assets, Keystone now has about $6.7 billion in assets and 10 member banks, which together operate 200 offices in Pennsylvania, Maryland and West Virginia.
